claims.text: Norway’s ICT accessibility authority (Uu-tilsynet) closed its supervision of Helseplattformen AS’s HelsaMi website on 23 December 2025 after the remaining identified errors were corrected. Daily penalties of NOK 50,000 had been triggered from 20 December; the authority reports that they ran for two days.
claims.authority_or_court: Tilsynet for universell utforming av ikt (Uu-tilsynet)
claims.legal_basis: Likestillings- og diskrimineringslova and forskrift om universell utforming av ikt, identified by the authority.
claims.stage_detail: Stage is limited to the dated source; no later outcome inferred.
claims.uncertainty: This is Norwegian ICT accessibility enforcement, not an established EAA case. Payment is not evidenced. Correction concerns defects found in this inspection, not certification of all website functions. The original entry misnames the authority and frames the service as a mobile app.
